<|channel|>analysis<|message|>We need to determine which option correctly matches the user manual's instructions. Let’s examine each statement.

A. Claim: projection angle adjustable 0-8°, left-right adjustment, operation: lift front, press release button, raise/lower front adjusting length of elevation adjustment foot, to retract, press down to lower. We need to check manual section about elevation adjustment foot. In the manual, the text says: "To change the projector elevation angle 1. Lift up the front of the projector and press the release button. 2. While holding down the release button, raise and lower the front of the projector until the elevation adjustment foot is approximately the length you need. 3. Release the release button to lock the elevation adjustment foot in its current position. 4. Rotate the elevation adjustment foot for fine adjustment of its length." Also mentions left and right adjustment feet for fine left/right. And to retract: "To retract the elevation adjustment foot, hold down the release button and slide the elevation adjustment foot back into the projector." That's slightly different: not pressing down to lower but sliding back. The description in A: "To retract the adjustment feet, you can simply press down to lower the projector to its normal angle." That seems incorrect: the manual says slide foot back, not press down to lower. So A maybe partly correct but statement about retract is wrong. But A also says "first lift front and press release button", "raise or lower front by adjusting length of angle adjustment feet to desired length," "To retract, simply press down to lower projector to normal angle." That last bit is not correct. So A is not fully correct.

B. When first turning on project, language selection window appears. You can use arrow keys to highlight language. Once set, cannot be changed permanently – but actually can be changed later: "You can change the display language selection later, if you need to." So B is wrong because says cannot be changed permanently. So B incorrect.

C. "When focusing the image displayed by the projector, it should be done using a non-static image. Typically, zooming after focusing will not change the focus of the image. You can use the zoom function to adjust the projection position and screen size." Let's check manual: Under "Zoom and Focus": "To adjust the image size, use the zoom ring. To focus the image, use the focus ring." In manual: "It is best to have a still image on the screen when you focus the image. Performing zoom after focusing can cause the image to go out of focus. If this happens, focus again." So manual says focusing should be done with a still image (static), not a non-static image. And zooming after focusing will cause focus issues. The statement says zooming after focusing will not change the focus of the image. That's opposite: it's true that zoom after focusing will distort focus. So statement is wrong. So C incorrect.

D. "Projector has internal lamp, after ~2000 hours LAMP indicator will start flashing red, indicates lamp replacement period. At this time, turn off projector, unplug AC, wait 60 minutes for lamp to cool, then turn projector upside down, loosen lamp cover, remove screws fixing lamp box, pull out lamp box, insert new lamp, secure screws, reattach lamp cover." Let's verify. Manual: lamp replacement: the LAMP indicator flashing red after lamp life reached. Then procedure: "Turn off projector. After the POWER/STANDBY indicator changes to steady amber, unplug AC. Next, wait at least 60 minutes before removing lamp." So yep. Also "Turn over projector and place it on top of a desk." Then steps for removing lamp. Need to turn projector upside down? Manual doesn't specifically say "turn projector upside down" but says "Turn over the projector and place it on top of a desk." Then remove lamp cover, remove lamp etc. That matches D. D also mentions turning projector upside down, which is equivalent. The phrase "turn projector upside down" might be considered correct. So D seems correct. Let's quickly compare:

Manual: The lamp can be replaced: "The lamp should be changed using YL-30 lamp. Steps: Turn off projector, unplug AC, wait 60 minutes. Turn over projector and place it on top of stable surface," etc. So D is accurate. 

Thus correct answer: D.

Provide final answer.

<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>final<|message|>\boxed{D}
